Aureon v1.8.13 — Automatic Seasonal Themes
- Automatic seasonal themes based on the Windows date: Halloween (October–November), Christmas (December–February), and Classic (March–September).
- New Appearance options in Settings: Auto, Classic, Halloween, and Christmas.
- All theme artwork is bundled for offline switching without reinstalling the app.
- Automatic update notifications remain available.
- Existing modpacks and profiles are retained during a standard upgrade.
